html:
The Wagon Ticket is a Ticket which is needed for using the Ore Wagon system in Kazordoon.

You can buy a Wagon Ticket for 250 gp from any of the Ore Wagon System Ticket Seller NPCs:

  • Lokur (Kazordoon Depot)
  • Brodrosch (Kazordoon's Steamship)
  • Dukosh
  • Lukosh
  • Pukosh
  • Gewen

The ticket lasts for one week and you will be able to transport between Depot, Shops, Temple, Steamship and Kazordoon's Main Gate.

After Updates/9.8, four new ore wagons have been added:

  • west of Kazordoon mountain
  • south of Kazordoon, near the Dwarven Bridge
  • north of Kazordoon mountain
  • on top of the Kazordoon mountain, near a new Magic Carpet
